description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing tellers and related entities within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving tellers, cashiers, transactions, and journals. The class, annotated with JAX-RS and Swagger annotations, interacts with service layers to handle business logic and serialization.

classes.name: TellerApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller class providing endpoints for managing tellers, cashiers, transactions, and journals in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: getTellerData
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of all tellers, optionally filtered by office ID.

methods.name: findTeller
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific teller by ID.

methods.name: createTeller
methods.description: Creates a new teller using provided data.

methods.name: updateTeller
methods.description: Updates an existing teller identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteTeller
methods.description: Deletes a teller identified by ID.

methods.name: getCashierData
methods.description: Lists cashiers associated with a teller within a date range.

methods.name: findCashierData
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific cashier by ID.

methods.name: getCashierTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a cashier template for a teller.

methods.name: createCashier
methods.description: Creates a new cashier for a teller.

methods.name: updateCashier
methods.description: Updates an existing cashier for a teller.

methods.name: getTransactionsForCashier
methods.description: Retrieves transactions related to a cashier with filtering and pagination options.

methods.name: getTransactionsWithSummaryForCashier
methods.description: Retrieves transactions along with summary data for a cashier.

methods.name: getCashierTxnTemplate
methods.description: Provides a transaction template for a cashier.

methods.name: getTransactionData
methods.description: Retrieves all teller transactions within a date range.

methods.name: findTransactionData
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific teller transaction.

methods.name: getJournalData
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries for a teller within a date range.
